name: CONFIGURE ME
_note: This mapping is a PLACEHOLDER and the url is deliberately invalid.
It is shaped after the community MLBB hero-rank APIs, but I could not reach any
live stats host from the machine this was written on, so nothing here is verified.
1. Open the source's JSON in a browser or with curl.
2. Set records_path to the dotted path of the array of heroes ('' if top level).
3. Set each field to the dotted path WITHIN one record.
It refuses to write unless at least 20 heroes map cleanly.
Candidate sources, in rough order of preference:
- www.mobilelegends.com/rank  (official, daily; find the XHR the page makes)
- github.com/ridwaanhall/api-mobilelegends  (open source; SELF-HOST it and this
Rates may be 0-1 or 0-100; the app normalises either.
